task.title: P6-068 residue: e2e observer disconnect, live_facts clone, quick_add comment trim
task.description:
Minor follow-ups from P6-068 adversarial review (none user-visible):

1. end2end/tests/collection-view.spec.ts ~:865-873 — the MutationObserver in the mounted-across-refresh test is never disconnect()ed; it survives only because each toPass retry does a fresh page.goto. Add a disconnect (or scope it) so a future refactor of the retry body cannot leak observers across retries.
2. app/src/my/collection.rs ~:291-294 — live_facts does facts.get(), cloning the whole QuickAddFacts (incl. Vec<PresentMatch>) per recompute; facts.with(|f| ...) with the id check inside avoids the clone. Not a regression (old resolved cloned the larger CollectionView), pure micro-efficiency.
3. app/src/components/quick_add.rs ~:408-420 — 13 lines of comment marking the absence of the deleted 120ms focus keeper, duplicating the P6-068 Resolution note. Trim to a one-line pointer.

Context: P6-068 (keep /my/* mounted across query refresh) merged; review verdict was SHIP with these as the residue.
